verdict.rationale: Gumloop shows some source-control integration — Organization Skills can be kept in sync with a GitHub repository, and Hosted MCP servers auto-build/deploy on every push to main — but there is no documented mechanism for versioning entire agent workflows in source control or promoting a full agent/workflow from a dev to a production environment. missing for 10: workflow-level git versioning, dev/staging/prod environment promotion, rollback/diff tooling for agents themselves.
